purpose: Five architectural group gate visual studies. Preview only; game code/runtime resources not changed.

groups.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Native classic Age of Empires 1 / Rise of Rome sprite study.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET with actual original game stone piers, flags and grass enlarged exactly 3x nearest-neighbor. Image 2 is the approved CONSTRUCTION AND WOOD/HINGE STYLE reference only; do not transfer Egyptian masonry from image 2 into image 1.
ONLY replace the bright magenta and cyan three-dimensional placeholder leaves and their pink/cyan top/end faces in image 1 with massive plain timber gate leaves. Replace the small yellow corner marks with robust functional iron strap hinges. Preserve the original masonry, caps or roofs, blue player flags and grass in image 1 exactly. Same framing and aspect ratio.
Left panel CLOSED: two leaves meet in the middle. Right panel OPEN 90 degrees toward the foreground: BOTH leaves remain visible in their exact placeholder positions in front-left of their own piers. Keep fixed corner hinge axes. Do not hide or remove the right open leaf.
Geometry is locked by the placeholders: fill their exact outlines. Each leaf is a solid thick slab with a broad visible top plane and free end face, about 6 native pixels of projected thickness. Do not thin it or alter its size. No arch, lintel, beam, connecting roof, wall extensions or extra stone blocks. Exactly two original flag-topped piers per panel.
Use four or five wide upright wooden planks, TWO broad dark iron reinforcing straps and TWO short vertical barrel hinges per leaf. Every strap continues to the hinged edge, wraps around the thick edge where needed, ends in a knuckle around an upright pin fixed into a compact iron plate on the stone corner. Follow image 2's clear mechanical connection. Yellow markers indicate fixed attachment points, must disappear completely. No hinges at central seam or free ends.
Faithful coarse original pixel sprite appearance and limited palette, upper-left light, subdued shadow, broad calm color clusters. Every source pixel is a 3x3 square in this reference. Avoid smooth modern 3D, HD details, glossy highlights and fine grain.
No rings, handles, tiny nails, nail patterns, medallions, symbols, animals, carved reliefs, gold edging or intricate cultural ornaments. The actual original architecture provides cultural identity. No text.
Architectural group: GREEK. Retain the exact pale gray stone piers, pale flat caps and broad blue player bands in image 1. Door material slightly weathered medium light brown oak, straight broad boards, plain dark iron hardware. Clean restrained construction. No Egyptian papyrus, Mesopotamian lions, Greek-key ornament or reliefs.

shared_design: Exactly two original architecture piers with original player blue flags.
No adjoining wall segments, extra blocks, overhead lintel or beam.
Heavy wood slabs with broad top and end faces; native projected thickness [6,3].
Two plain iron reinforcement straps per leaf continued into corner pin hinges.
Closed pair and two fully visible leaves opened 90 degrees toward foreground.
No tiny insignia, reliefs or intricate ornamental decoration.
compositing: ImageGen paints constrained three-dimensional leaf surfaces and hinge zones. Paint extracted to native leaf masks and quantized to 107 colors sampled from existing original sprites. Original right foreground restored for closed pose; local generated dark neutral iron layer added over source corner attachments. All source pixels outside gate drawing regions unchanged.
art_source: prototype/assets/generated/*.png imported from original AoE1/RoR, metadata assets.json and graphics-catalog.json.
status: Visual concepts; no gameplay, imported sprite registration or hinge animation code has been implemented.
